categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the electric power distribution network information security sector, focusing on the development, production, and sales of intelligent security devices and information security cloud platforms. It also provides industrial internet information security overall solutions and information technology services including software development, system integration, and operation maintenance, mainly serving the power industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include industrial security communication based on national cryptographic algorithms, heterogeneous communication integration (2G/3G/4G/5G, NB-IoT, LoRa, ZigBee), low-power dynamic power adjustment, secure operating system customization and hardening, multi-processor coordination for small secure terminals, extensive industrial protocol filtering, protocol message rapid processing, industrial data security management with real-time simulation, software-defined hybrid cloud security, and large-scale data secure storage. The company emphasizes independent R&D and integration of cryptography, communication, and automation technologies, with products adapted to domestic secure operating systems and hardware.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major power grid companies such as State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, as well as well-known power equipment providers like Beijing Kerei, Changyuan Shenrui, and Zhuhai XJ Electric. The company also serves industrial sectors including water conservancy, communications, transportation, and military industries, with a focus on electric power distribution network information security.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales in regions including East China, South China, Southwest China, North China, Central China, and Northwest China. Its customer base includes national and regional power grid companies and related enterprises across these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on R&D, design, and sales of security hardware and software products for electric power distribution networks. It outsources some non-core manufacturing processes such as PCB assembly to external vendors, emphasizing core technology development and customer service.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include leveraging 5G, AI, edge computing, and cloud technologies to enhance product innovation and security capabilities. The company focuses on continuous R&D investment in industrial security communication, data security management, and cloud platforms, aiming to develop customized, domestically controlled, and secure products. It also plans to expand into new industries like transportation, water conservancy, communications, and military sectors while strengthening its marketing and talent acquisition.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of intelligent security devices and information security cloud platform software, supplemented by technical services including software development, system integration, and maintenance. The company uses a direct sales model mainly to end customers such as power grid companies and equipment providers, with a smaller portion through distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the electric power distribution network information security niche, recognized for its strong R&D capabilities and early market entry. Major competitors include large established security firms like Beijing Venustech and Westone. The company differentiates itself through domestically developed core technologies, integration with national cryptographic standards, and close cooperation with major power grid enterprises.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 120 million, a 13.89% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 18 million, down 53.33%. The company has a total asset base of around RMB 867 million and equity of RMB 836 million. Despite recent revenue and profit declines due to economic conditions and reduced government subsidies, the company maintains positive cash flow from operations and continues investing in R&D and infrastructure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes autonomous innovation, high security based on national cryptographic algorithms, and compatibility with domestic secure operating systems, providing highly reliable, low-latency, and energy-efficient security solutions tailored for complex industrial environments. Its products offer comprehensive protection for power distribution networks, integrating hardware and software for secure communication, data encryption, and real-time threat detection, thereby ensuring the safety and stability of critical power infrastructure.
